evidence.quote: '''Black dragonhide''' (also called '''Black d'hide''' by [[tanner]]s) is a 100% drop from [[black dragon]]s, [[brutal black dragon]]s, [[lava dragon]]s, and the [[King Black Dragon]]. The hide can be tanned to become [[black dragon leather]] by paying a [[tanner]] or by using the [[Tan Leather]] lunar spell. A tanner will charge 20 coins for each hide, or 45 in Canifis. Tanners can be found in [[Al Kharid]], the [[Ranging Guild]], [[Canifis]], the [[Crafting Guild]], [[Auburnvale]], and [[Forthos Dungeon]].

A '''fishbowl''' is an item that can be created with level 42 [[Crafting]] or received as a drop from [[Mogre]]s. It can be filled with [[water]] and then with [[seaweed]]. With a filled fishbowl in the inventory, a [[tiny net]] can be purchased from [[Harry]] in [[Catherby]] for 10 gold which can then be used to catch a fish in the [[aquarium]] to get a [[pet fish]]. This is one of the tasks in the [[Easy Kandarin Diary]].

[[File:Iron bar detail.png|left|120px]]
An '''iron bar''' is a [[bar]] of refined [[Iron ore|iron]]. It can be created through the [[Smithing]] [[skill]] at level 15 by using [[iron ore]] on a [[furnace]], granting 12.5 Smithing [[experience]]. When smelting iron ore, there is a 50% chance that it will be too impure; it disappears, yielding no Smithing experience nor an iron bar. However, wearing a [[ring of forging]], casting [[Superheat Item]], or using the [[Blast Furnace]] would give a 100% success rate.
